datum: Visual assembly origin near wing quarter chord; NOT a measured CG

wing.span.source: signed Jensen oz1253 title block, 60 in

wing.chord.source: 720 in² / 60 in = 12 in representative chord; rectangular visual simplification

wing.section.source: Jensen qualitative semisymmetric section, flat aft underside; coordinates chosen for visual mesh, NOT NACA or aerodynamic polar

wing.dihedral_deg.source: visual angle initially atan(1.5/30); plan tip-rise callout is not a published angle; installed angle awaits calibration

fuselage_stations.method: z/top/bottom remain visual estimates; halfwidth interpolated from manual plan-view pixel picks at x=48+(z+0.44)/1.12*2002, using conditional 0.533206 mm/px. Longitudinal span fitted to existing 1.12m visual envelope, not a calibrated plan dimension. V2 maps only stations ahead of fixed wing LE affinely from old F1=-0.44 to measured F1=-0.291276; widths/heights retained as visual estimates. See model-v2-nose.json.
fuselage_stations.scope: source points describe the raster; no independent absolute scale; side-view trace and unresolved tail outline not adopted

tail.source: Estimated rounded Jensen-like silhouette after visual inspection of signed plan; exact tail trace unresolved, no ambiguous callout coordinates imported

equipment.wheels.source: Jensen plan 2.75 in nose, selected 3 in main from 3 or 3.25 in callout

equipment.engine.source: visual .61 single cylinder, provisional envelope informed by O.S. MAX-61FX manual p40; accessories simplified; brand not selected

equipment.other.source: 12in prop and gear placement remain estimated. V2 moves prop and nose axle with F1 by +0.148724m, preserving installation offsets; shaft height and main gear unchanged.

decoration.source: red/cream top and charcoal underside selected for readability; not claimed as a canonical livery

equipment.firewall_z.source: research/d1/jensen_plan_cg.py; signed Jensen oz1253 page1; F1frontx114, LEx808 at100dpi
equipment.firewall_z.scope: Local scan reading; page scale supported by 12.07in chord vs 12in nominal, not a globally calibrated built-aircraft dimension
